wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.description: No fixed past, no fixed loyalties. A clean slate and a road ahead.

acolyte.name: Acolyte
acolyte.description: Raised in a temple, trained in doctrine, ritual and the care of the faithful.

criminal.name: Criminal
criminal.description: You know the language of fences, locked doors and quiet arrangements.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.description: You learned discipline, formation and how to make a threat sound like a promise.

sage.name: Sage
sage.description: Years among old books left you with a memory for runes, ledgers and forgotten names.

outlander.name: Outlander
outlander.description: You grew up beyond the walls, reading weather, tracks and the mood of the road.
